content:
I am pleased to announce that the first ever Mathlib Reviewer Bootcamp will take place at Stockholm University from 30th March to 3rd April 2026, featuring lectures by @Andrew Yang, @Michael Rothgang and myself.

Its goal is to make existing Lean experts proficient at reviewing pull requests to Mathlib, and thus increase its long-term growth capacity.

See https://yaeldillies.github.io/mrb2026 for the full info and how to apply.
Deadline: 28th February 2026 AoE.

I have received several questions about the travel funding. Unsurprisingly, we do not have infinite money and I would therefore encourage prospective participants to cover their travel costs through their home institution to the extent possible. I have clarified the webpage above.
Please use #mathlib4 > Mathlib Reviewer Bootcamp for further discussion.
Update: It turns out the university will be fully closed for Good Friday (3rd April), hence we are ending the bootcamp one day earlier (Thursday 2nd) and scraping the excursion on Wednesday. Sorry!
